Lee: quick share 10hey team 10 got two bits of news: accepted Senior SWE role yesterday, and also were expecting a little human in December! overwhelmed but happy. 
Asha: WHOA double congrats!! :tada: :baby: Senior SWE = huge. we need confetti and coffee.
Talia: double win!! official office ceremony is required. can we do a lunchtime mini-shower + card?
Sam: absolutely. whos good for organizing? i can bring a banner and terrible dad-joke balloons. :joy:
Lee: love it. maybe keep it low-key during lunch. no gifts necessary but i put together a tiny registry link for people asking: https://example.com/lee-registry (totally optional)
Marco: ill take care of ordering food. poll: sandwiches, sushi, or salad boxes?
Noor: sandwich + cupcakes for dessert? also note: Lee is avoiding shellfish.
Asha: cupcakes for sure. chocolate + lemon options? or we do a mix.
People Ops Bot: people-ops-bot added "Lee - Senior SWE + Baby Lunch" to #company-calendar on 2025-11-07 at 12:30. RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/evt/2047
Talia: ill make a card and leave it at reception. who wants to sign?
Sam: me! also i have a silly GIF to use: https://giphy.com/silly-confetti
Marco: ill sign and chip in for a group gift. lee, any registry items that are okay from afar (books or gift cards)?
Lee: books and coffee shop gift cards are perfect, thank you. and seriously you all being excited means a lot. not expecting anything big, just the company.
Noor: marking myself for decorations + photoshoot duties. Miras out but ill try to make non-awkward photos.
Asha: ill drop off napkins and bring a tiny party hat.
Sam: countdown begins. congrats again lee 44f
Lee: thank youuuu 970 cant wait to celebrate with you all.
